title: A worker answering BLOCKED or NEEDS_CONTEXT is re-dispatched a tier up with its question; at the ceiling the repo's standing orders decide
description: Today an implement worker's BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT is attempt_needs_human: the run stops for a person (dispatch.go ~2934, RefusedNeedsHuman). Under the hand-off model the next human touch point is the PR. Instead: re-dispatch one tier up with the worker's question and detail in the prompt ('an earlier attempt stopped here because: …; decide and proceed'); at the ceiling, apply .tick/config.md's standing orders (decide-and-log classes) — the worker decides and logs; only a question in an 'always ask' class becomes a hold, and that hold is surfaced in the epic PR body rather than stopping unrelated ticks where possible. Every step an event naming the question.
acceptance_criteria: A BLOCKED implement answer is re-dispatched at the next tier with the question in the prompt; at the ceiling a decide-and-log question is decided and logged; only an always-ask class holds, and the hold names the question
closed_reason: Completed: a BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT answer is re-dispatched one tier up with the question (carrying its commits); at the ceiling a decide-and-log question is decided under .tick/config.md's standing orders and logged; only an always-ask question holds, naming it, holding only its own tick and listed in the epic PR body
